methodology.overallScore: 90% original reviewer star rating and 10% extracted review-text satisfaction. If fewer than five text-satisfaction reviews are available, the grade uses star ratings alone and says so.
methodology.aggregation: Repeated claims are averaged within each review before review-level results are combined. Positive evidence is weighted from +1.0 at 6 to +1.4 at 10; negative evidence subtracts symmetrically from -1.0 at 4 to -1.4 at 0.
methodology.minimumEvidence: Findings require at least five distinct reviews.
methodology.limitations: Retailer reviews are self-selected and may not represent every CPAP patient. Text findings were extracted by an AI model and are not medical advice.
